### TASK 1B:

Consider prediction of an event: 1 = event (positive), 0 = no event (negative).

Use the general confusion matrix:

|   | **Predicted positive** | **Predicted negative** |
|:--------------------|:------------------------:|:------------------------:|
| **Actual positive** | [**True Positive (TP)**]{style="color: #21803a;"} | [**False Negative (FN)**]{style="color: #c0392b;"} |
| **Actual negative** | [**False Positive (FP)**]{style="color: #c0392b;"} | [**True Negative (TN)**]{style="color: #21803a;"} |

We have already seen that

$$
\text{Accuracy} = \frac{TP+TN}{TP+TN+FP+FN}
$$

What are the corresponding equations for sensitivity (recall), specificity and precision?
